note: Hand-written source of the chapter 5 ⚡ stage (Build B1, 17 Nov 2026). tools/build_stretch.py turns it into content/ms/stretch/x05.json. Malay: Malaysian standard, standard form first, no spoken forms (no «nak», «tapi», «macam mana», «tapau»), chapter 5 affix gates (no ber-, meN-, -kan or -i; -nya from chapter 2), chapter 1 to 5 words only («puas makan», not «puas hati»: «hati» is a Jambatan row). Cari Benda ⚡ on the «Lepak di kedai mamak» picture scene. All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

L-1369.en: Great, impressive: «Wah, hebat!» = Wow, impressive! Said to an adult who does something well.
L-1369.ja: すごい、立派な：«Wah, hebat!»＝わあ、すごい！大人がうまくできたときに。

L-1319.en: Wrong, mistaken; opposite of «betul» (Ch3). «salah jawab» = to answer wrongly.
L-1319.ja: まちがった。«betul»（第3課）の反対。«salah jawab»＝答えをまちがえる。

L-1323.en: About, concerning: «tentang durian» = about durians. In speech also «pasal».
L-1323.ja: 〜について：«tentang durian»＝ドリアンについて。話し言葉では «pasal» とも。

L-1327.en: To see, spot; to look, seem: «nampak sedap» = looks delicious.
L-1327.ja: 見える；〜に見える：«nampak sedap»＝おいしそう。

L-1332.en: Way, method: «Bagaimana cara …?» = How do you …?
L-1332.ja: 方法、やり方：«Bagaimana cara …?»＝どうやって〜するの？

L-1344.en: Sound, noise. «bunyinya» = the way it sounds.

L-1533.en: Bad (looks, smell, quality). «bau buruk» = a bad smell.
L-1533.ja: 悪い、ひどい（見た目、におい、質）。«bau buruk»＝いやなにおい。

L-1534.en: The king of fruits: strong smell, sweet taste.
L-1534.ja: 果物の王様。においが強く、味は甘い。

L-1535.en: kira (Ch5), said twice: about, roughly. «kira-kira dua puluh minit» = about twenty minutes.
L-1535.ja: kira（第5課）を2回：約、だいたい。«kira-kira dua puluh minit»＝約20分。

L-1537.ja: 牛乳。«teh susu»＝ミルクティー。

L-1538.en: To grill, bake, burn. «daging bakar» = grilled meat.
L-1538.ja: 焼く。«daging bakar»＝焼き肉（あぶった肉）。

L-1539.ja: 誇らしい：«Saya bangga.»＝誇りに思います。

L-1545.en: Nut, peanut, bean. «kuah kacang» = peanut sauce (for satay).
L-1545.ja: ナッツ、ピーナッツ、豆。«kuah kacang»＝ピーナッツソース（サテ用）。

L-1547.ja: レモン。«air lemon»＝レモンの飲み物。

L-1549.en: Noodles: the spelling on menus and signs («mee goreng»); the same word as «mi» (Ch5).
L-1549.ja: 麺。メニューや看板のつづり（«mee goreng»）。«mi»（第5課）と同じ語。

L-1551.en: Clever, good at: «pandai masak» = good at cooking.
L-1551.ja: 上手な、かしこい：«pandai masak»＝料理が上手。

L-1552.en: Thick, strong (of tea or coffee): «teh pekat».
L-1552.ja: 濃い（お茶やコーヒー）：«teh pekat»。

L-1553.en: Satisfied: «puas makan» = to have eaten your fill.
L-1553.ja: 満足した：«puas makan»＝思う存分食べた。

L-1554.en: Satay: grilled meat on sticks, with peanut sauce.
L-1554.ja: サテ：串焼きの肉、ピーナッツソース付き。

L-1555.ja: スナック、軽食（英語から）。

frames.example: Bau durian ini buruk, tetapi rasanya sedap.
frames.meaning_en: This durian smells bad, but it tastes good.
frames.meaning_ja: このドリアンはにおいがひどいけど、味はおいしい。

frames.example: Saya minum kopi pekat tanpa gula.
frames.meaning_en: I drink strong coffee without sugar.
frames.meaning_ja: 濃いコーヒーを砂糖なしで飲みます。

frames.frame: Anak saya ___ sebab dia ___ jawab soalan itu.
frames.example: Anak saya malu sebab dia salah jawab soalan itu.
frames.meaning_en: My child is embarrassed because he answered that question wrongly.
frames.meaning_ja: 子どもはその質問に答えをまちがえて、恥ずかしがっています。

frames.frame: Bagaimana cara masak ___ ini? Goreng dengan ___ dan ___.
frames.example: Bagaimana cara masak mee ini? Goreng dengan bawang dan cendawan.
frames.meaning_en: How do you cook these noodles? Fry them with onion and mushrooms.
frames.meaning_ja: この麺はどうやって作るの？玉ねぎときのこと一緒に炒めます。

frames.example: Kafe itu nampak kecil, tetapi makanannya istimewa.
frames.meaning_en: That café looks small, but its food is special.
frames.meaning_ja: あのカフェは小さく見えるけど、料理は特別です。

frames.example: Kami tunggu kira-kira dua puluh minit di mamak itu.
frames.meaning_en: We waited about twenty minutes at that mamak stall.
frames.meaning_ja: 私たちはそのママックの店で20分ぐらい待ちました。

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Encik Tanaka, Encik pernah makan durian?
lines.en: Mr Tanaka, have you ever eaten durian?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Belum. Saya tahu tentang durian, tetapi saya takut baunya.
lines.en: Not yet. I know about durian, but I'm scared of its smell.
choices: Sudah, tetapi saya tidak tahu tentang durian.
Belum. Saya minum teh tarik setiap hari.
choices_en: Yes, but I don't know about durian.
Not yet. I drink teh tarik every day.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Baunya tidak sedap, tetapi rasanya manis dan sedap!
lines.en: It doesn't smell nice, but it tastes sweet and delicious!

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Ambil satu dan rasa sedikit dulu. Durian ini istimewa: kuning dan manis.
lines.en: Take one and have a little taste first. This durian is special: yellow and sweet.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
choices_en: Wow, it's really salty and spicy!

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Encik boleh makan durian! Wah, hebat!
lines.en: You can eat durian! Wow, impressive!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Terima kasih! Sekarang saya lapar. Sate itu nampak sedap.
lines.en: Thank you! Now I'm hungry. That satay looks delicious.

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Ya, sate itu istimewa: daging bakar dengan kuah kacang.
lines.en: Yes, that satay is special: grilled meat with peanut sauce.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Saya mahu sate dan mee goreng. Cik mahu minum apa?
lines.en: I'd like satay and fried noodles. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: Cik Mei Ling
lines.ms: Air lemon panas dengan madu. Tekak saya sakit.
lines.en: Hot lemon with honey. I have a sore throat.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Saya nak teh tarik, kurang manis.
lines.en: I'd like teh tarik, less sweet. («nak»: spoken «mahu»)
choices: Tekak saya sakit. Saya mahu air sejuk dengan ais.
Saya nak teh tarik, tanpa teh.
choices_en: I have a sore throat. I want a cold drink with ice.
I'd like teh tarik, without the tea.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Puas! Malam ini seronok sekali. Terima kasih, Cik Mei Ling.
lines.en: Yes, I'm full and happy! Tonight was great fun. Thank you, Ms Mei Ling.
choices: Tidak. Saya kecewa sebab sate itu sedap.
choices_en: No. I'm disappointed because the satay was delicious.
